summary: Autodoc reference for ansible.module_utils.common.parameters, including DEFAULT_TYPE_VALIDATORS, which maps type names like 'str' to their default check functions.
questions: Which function validates the 'str' type in an argument spec?

answer_card.title: DEFAULT_TYPE_VALIDATORS
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.module_utils.common.parameters.DEFAULT_TYPE_VALIDATORS` is a dict mapping type names (such as `'str'`) to the default function used to check that type. For `'str'` it is `ansible.module_utils.common.validation.check_type_str`.
